download.body: The languages come from Mozilla's servers, the ones Firefox translates with: they see that this computer asked for them. Translating then happens on this computer, and your messages never leave it.
download.engine: The first download also brings the translation engine, from Ghostly's releases on GitHub.
download.goesOn: You can close this: the download goes on, and you are told here if it fails.
download.title: Download translation?
